name: Titanium

properties.name: buildHash
properties.summary: Git hash of the Titanium build.

properties.name: version
properties.summary: Version of Titanium that is executing.

methods.name: createBuffer
methods.summary: Creates a new buffer based on the params.

examples.title: Create a buffer with string
examples.code:
Create a buffer with the string "hello world" encoded in UTF-8
``` js
var buffer = Ti.createBuffer({ value: "hello world" });
```

examples.title: Create a buffer with encoded float
examples.code:
Create a buffer with the encoded value of the double-precision floating point
number 1.234567 in Big Endian (network) byte order
``` js
var buffer = Ti.createBuffer({ value: 1.234567, type: Ti.Codec.TYPE_DOUBLE, byteOrder: Ti.Codec.BIG_ENDIAN });
```

inlined.name: CreateBufferArgs
inlined.summary: Arguments to be passed to createBuffer

properties.name: byteOrder
properties.summary: The byte order of this buffer.
properties.default: The OS native byte order is used by default. See <Titanium.Codec.getNativeByteOrder>

properties.name: length
properties.default: 0, unless `value` is specified, in which case the length of the encoded data is used.

properties.name: type
properties.summary: The type of data encoding to use with `value`.
properties.default: <Titanium.Codec.CHARSET_UTF8> if `value` is a String, If `value` is a Number, this argument is required

properties.name: value
properties.summary: An initial value which will be encoded and placed in the buffer. If value is a Number, type must also be set. (this is simply a convenient way of calling [Titanium.Codec.encodeString](api:Titanium.Codec#encodeString) or [Titanium.Codec.encodeNumber](api:Titanium.Codec#encodeNumber) and placing the encoded value in the returned buffer.)
